public_metadata.run_browser_experiment_design: DNA from silica-dried leaf/herbarium material; COS1061 enrichment; unenriched libraries mixed with target-enriched libraries at 3:2 before sequencing.
public_metadata.run_browser_read_structure: 2 biological reads per spot; 125 bp each

paper_statement: Moreyra et al. 2025 states that Table S1 contains detailed sample information, BioSample accessions, herbaria codes and voucher information.
interpretation_boundary: Because unenriched and enriched libraries were mixed 3:2, raw target mapping fraction cannot be interpreted as capture/reference success; use HybPiper locus recovery and downstream orthology/reference-concordance metrics.
